newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Widetech debut delayed by glitch.
newsitem.headline: Widetech debut delayed by glitch.

text.p: A technical glitch has delayed Tuesday's listing of Malaysia's Widetech Corp Bhd, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
"It's a technical hitch," the official told Reuters. "Our I.T. (information technology) side is still looking at the problem."
Widetech, a maker of correction fluid and engineering components, offered 3.593 million shares at 2.10 ringgit apiece for its listing on the second board of the exchange.
